hero.title: Gojek × Navier — the super-app, on the water of the world's largest archipelago
hero.subtitle: Indonesia is 17,000+ islands and Gojek is its home-grown super-app. Water is the transport surface no one owns yet.
hero.what_we_do_together: We launch a Gojek-branded foiling water tier across Indonesia's densest island crossings and cross-border corridors — booked in-app, premium-priced, category-defining in the largest archipelago on earth. Navier brings the software-defined hydrofoiling fleet and the network playbook now proven in the Maldives; Gojek brings the demand, the app, GoPay, and home-turf reach across Indonesia and Singapore. Together we turn slow, weather-exposed, accident-prone ferry crossings into fast, smooth, safe in-app water trips — and claim the category in the one country where water is the nation.

why_now: Foiling lifts the hull clear of the water: faster, dramatically more efficient per passenger-mile, smooth and near-silent, hybrid-capable with no charging-infrastructure dependency, and autonomy-ready. A ~100-vessel network is already ramping in the Maldives (WSJ/Bloomberg, 2026), Singapore's regulator is mandating clean harbour craft from 2030, and Indonesia's most-trafficked crossings (Bali↔Nusa, Batam↔Singapore) are infamous for slow, accident-prone diesel boats. The category gets claimed cluster-by-cluster — and the world's largest archipelago is the surface that matters most.
multimodal_fit: Gojek already runs the hardest parts: real-time demand, dispatch, dynamic pricing, GoPay, and a GoRide/GoCar driver-partner network across Indonesia and Singapore. A foiling water tier slots straight in — same app, same wallet, captain-partners instead of driver-partners, the water leg booked door-to-door with the GoRide to and from the pier. Navier is simply the missing surface in a multimodal map Gojek already operates across the archipelago.

This is the showcase for a clean foiling water tier — fast low-wake Pioneer II hops within the islands and Quanta-LR hybrid runs across the open-water gaps — turning the planet's greatest reef into a connected, in-app network bookable in Gojek.

objections.concern: It is a freshwater lake, not the sea.
objections.response: Pioneer II is built for sheltered water and the calm caldera lake is an ideal operating environment — short crossings, no swell, and a clean low-wake profile that suits a protected inland sea.

objections.concern: Existing ferries are cheap.
objections.response: Navier targets the premium and reliability tier — a fast, smooth, bookable crossing — alongside the budget ferry, as the super-priority destination grows its visitor base.

objections.concern: Demand is seasonal and domestic-led.
objections.response: A software-defined fleet scales with the season; the in-app layer aggregates demand across the lake's scattered villages and resorts into one bookable tier.
